summary: Completed backend pytest regression and broad frontend E2E validation for landing/login, employee connected state, assessments, trainer upload, admin analytics, reports exports, users, and responsive behavior against external preview URL.

integration_issues.flow: Reports export modal used sequentially (PDF then CSV/Excel)
integration_issues.issue: CSV/Excel download event intermittently did not trigger in same session after PDF export (timed out twice); each format works in fresh modal/session and direct CSV+Excel run succeeded.

issues: Browser console repeatedly logs Recharts container warnings: width(-1)/height(-1), indicating unstable chart mount/layout calculations on initial render or route transitions.
Browser console logs React HTML nesting/hydration error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (likely rendering transform/instrumentation issue around option labels).

action_items: Fix console error source for '<span> inside <option>' to remove hydration/runtime noise.
Stabilize chart containers to eliminate Recharts width/height -1 warnings.
Harden report export modal sequence handling so PDF->CSV->Excel works reliably in one uninterrupted user flow.
Re-run frontend console-clean verification after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/App.css is very large (>700 lines, currently much larger) and should be split into focused stylesheet modules for maintainability and safer regression impact.
All core API computations/state-sync behaved deterministically in testing; no backend business-logic defects were detected in covered flows.
MOCKED integrations are correctly disclosed in UI for AI/iGOT/NSSTA/document extraction/demo auth flows.
test_credentials: Checked /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth tests; file exists but is empty. Demo role auth requires no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is in /app/backend/tests/test_prototype_api.py (11 tests, all passing). Frontend verified major requested flows on external URL with multiple fresh sessions/viewports. If retesting reports export, validate sequential multi-format exports in one session (observed intermittent timeout after prior PDF).
rca of the issue: RCA (frontend console): repeated Recharts warnings come from chart components mounting with transient invalid container dimensions during route/render transitions; hydration error indicates invalid transformed markup around native <option> elements where an extra <span> wrapper is introduced. Export flakiness appears timing/state related in modal lifecycle after prior export action, not a full hard failure of CSV/Excel generation.
